description: This PHP source file defines a controller class for the OpenCart e-commerce platform, specifically for handling currency operations related to European Central Bank (ECB) exchange rates. It includes methods for displaying a currency configuration page, saving configuration settings, and fetching/updating currency exchange rates from ECB's XML feed.

classes.name: ECB
classes.description: Controller class for managing currency exchange rates from ECB within the OpenCart admin extension.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the currency configuration page with breadcrumb navigation and current settings.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving of currency configuration settings; returns JSON success or error message.

methods.name: currency
methods.description: Fetches exchange rates from ECB's XML feed, updates local currency data, and clears currency cache.
